# Browserbase Documentation

> Browserbase is the Browser Agent Platform: one API key gives your agent everything it needs to browse and interact with the web like a human: Browsers, Fetch, Search, Agent Identity, Functions, and the Model Gateway.

- [Agents](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/agents/overview.md): Run autonomous browser agents on Browserbase with one API call.
- [Integrating Agents](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/agents/integrate-api-sdk.md): Create and manage Agents, trigger runs, pass variables, and track runs to completion.
- [Functions](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/functions/overview.md): A Browserbase Function runs your TypeScript code next to a Browserbase browser and exposes it through an API.
- [Functions limits](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/functions/limits.md): Reference for Browserbase Functions regions, timeouts, build size, parameters, storage, and language support.
- [Registering endpoints](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/webhooks/registering-endpoints.md): Create, list, update, rotate, and delete webhook endpoints with the Browserbase SDK.
- [Example](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/webhooks/example.md): A complete webhook receiver for Function invocations, from registering the endpoint to handling the event.
- [Web Bot Auth](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/identity/web-bot-auth.md): Give your browser traffic a verifiable identity with Web Bot Auth. Learn how request signing works and request beta access.
- [Model Gateway](https://docs.browserbase.com/platform/model-gateway/overview.md): Access top LLM providers through your Browserbase API key: one key, one bill, no provider accounts needed.
- [Cost optimization](https://docs.browserbase.com/optimizations/cost/cost-optimization.md): Your guide to lowering your browser infrastructure costs
- [Bring your own storage (BYOS)](https://docs.browserbase.com/account/enterprise/byos-setup-guide.md): Configure your own AWS S3 buckets for storing Browserbase artifacts
- [Plans & pricing](https://docs.browserbase.com/account/billing/plans.md): Your guide to Browserbase plans, pricing, and usage limits
- [APIs and SDKs](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/introduction.md): Access Browserbase through its REST API or official SDKs.
- [Overview](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/overview.md): Authentication, errors, pagination, and resources in the Browserbase REST API.
- [Overview](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/sdk/overview.md): Official Python and Node.js clients for the Browserbase API.
- [Node.js SDK](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/sdk/nodejs.md): Install and configure the Browserbase Node.js SDK.
- [Python SDK](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/sdk/python.md): Install and configure the Browserbase Python SDK.
- [Create a Session](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-a-session.md)
- [List Sessions](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-sessions.md)
- [Get a Session](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-session.md)
- [Update a Session](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/update-a-session.md): Close a Browserbase session by updating its status to REQUEST_RELEASE, or update other mutable session fields.
- [Create Session Uploads](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-session-uploads.md)
- [Set Session Labels](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/set-session-labels.md): Atomically replace a session's labels. Returns the response after the assignment commits.
- [List Labels](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-labels.md): List the project's labels, newest first. Page by passing the previous response's `nextCursor` as `cursor`; a null `nextCursor` means there are no further pages.
- [Create a Label](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-a-label.md): Create a project-owned label.
- [Update a Label](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/update-a-label.md): Rename a label, preserving its ID, creation time, and session assignments.
- [Delete a Label](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-a-label.md): Delete a label and its session assignments, preserving the sessions. Missing and other-project labels are successful no-ops.
- [Session Live URLs](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/session-live-urls.md)
- [Session Logs](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/session-logs.md)
- [Get Session Replay](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/session-replays.md): Returns page metadata for a session replay, including timing information and the URL of each page's HLS playlist.
- [Get Replay Page](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/session-replay-page.md): Returns an HLS VOD media playlist (.m3u8) for a specific page of a session replay.
- [Create Session Recording Downloads](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-session-recording-downloads.md): Requests one downloadable MP4 per recorded page of a session. Assembly runs asynchronously and every page returns as `PENDING`. Re-posting re-enqueues all pages and retries any that failed. Poll the GET endpoint for per-page status and, on standard (non-BYOS) projects, download URLs.
- [List Session Recording Downloads](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-session-recording-downloads.md): Returns the per-page download status for a session, with a short-lived signed URL for each completed page on standard (non-BYOS) projects.
- [Create a Context](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-a-context.md)
- [Get a Context](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-context.md)
- [Delete a Context](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-a-context.md)
- [List Downloads](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-downloads.md): List all downloads for a session with optional filtering and pagination.
- [Get a Download](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-download.md): Get download metadata (Accept: application/json) or file content (Accept: application/octet-stream).
- [Delete a Download](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-a-download.md): Delete a download file from storage and mark as deleted.
- [Upload an Extension](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/upload-an-extension.md)
- [Get an Extension](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-an-extension.md)
- [Delete an Extension](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-an-extension.md)
- [Upload a Certificate](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/upload-a-certificate.md): Upload a PEM file with one or more CA certificates (up to 100 MB). Pass the returned ID in `proxySettings.caCertificates` when creating a session so the browser trusts these certificates.
- [List Certificates](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-certificates.md): List the certificates uploaded to your project.
- [Get a Certificate](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-certificate.md): Retrieve metadata for an uploaded certificate by its ID, including its project ID and timestamps. The PEM content is not returned.
- [Delete a Certificate](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-a-certificate.md): Delete an uploaded certificate from your project by its ID. Session creation requests that still reference this ID in `proxySettings.caCertificates` fail with HTTP 400.
- [Create a Navigation Policy](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-a-navigation-policy.md): Create a navigation policy for this project. Omitted fields take the defaults: enabled, block by default, block unknown domains, no category rules, and no overrides. Bind the policy to a session with `browserSettings.riskPolicyId`.
- [List Navigation Policies](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-navigation-policies.md): List the project's navigation policies, ordered by name.
- [Get a Navigation Policy](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-navigation-policy.md): Retrieve a single navigation policy by ID.
- [Update a Navigation Policy](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/update-a-navigation-policy.md): Update a navigation policy. Omitted fields keep their values; a supplied list replaces the stored list rather than adding to it. The change applies to sessions that start afterwards; running sessions keep the policy they started with.
- [Delete a Navigation Policy](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-a-navigation-policy.md): Delete a navigation policy. New sessions can no longer bind to it; running sessions keep the policy they started with.
- [Run an Agent](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/run-an-agent.md): Run a browser agent to complete the `task` by using web search and browser tooling. Optionally pass `agentId` to run a [custom agent](/reference/api/create-an-agent) you've created.
- [Get a Run](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-run.md): Retrieve the current status and details of a run, including its result and associated session information. To fetch the run's messages, use [List Run Messages](/reference/api/list-run-messages).
- [List Runs](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-runs.md): List runs across your account. Supports filtering by status, by the agent they reference, and by creation time.
- [List Run Messages](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-run-messages.md): Returns a paginated list of messages produced by a run, in chronological order, with the oldest messages first.
- [Resume a Run](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/resume-a-run.md): Resume a `PAUSED` run with additional input. The reply in `task` is delivered to the agent as the answer to its pause request (the trailing `pause` tool call in the run's messages), and `variables` merge over the run's original variables. Resuming a run that is not paused returns a conflict.
- [Stop a Run](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/stop-a-run.md): Request that an in-progress run stop. The run winds down and transitions to `STOPPED`. Stopping a run that has already finished returns a conflict.
- [Create an Agent](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-an-agent.md): Create a reusable agent. An agent defines a `systemPrompt` and `resultSchema` that guide its behavior for every run. Only `name` is required; an agent created with no `systemPrompt` behaves like an unconfigured run.
- [Get an Agent](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-an-agent.md): Retrieve an agent by ID.
- [List Agents](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-agents.md): List agents across your account. Supports filtering by creation time.
- [Update an Agent](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/update-an-agent.md): Update an existing agent. Only the fields provided in the body are modified; omitted fields are left unchanged.
- [Delete an Agent](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-an-agent.md): Delete an agent. Runs that already referenced this agent are unaffected.
- [List Functions](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-functions.md)
- [Get a Function](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-function.md)
- [Invoke a Function](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/invoke-a-function.md)
- [List Function Secrets](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-function-secrets.md): List secrets attached to a function. Supports filtering by secret creation time. Returns metadata only.
- [Attach a Secret to a Function](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/attach-a-secret-to-a-function.md): Attach a secret to a Function, taking effect on the Function's next invocation. Note: Attaching a secret that is already attached succeeds to support idempotency.
- [Detach a Secret from a Function](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/detach-a-secret-from-a-function.md): Detach a secret from a Function, taking effect on the Function's next invocation. Note: Detaching a secret that is not attached succeeds to support idempotency.
- [List Function Versions](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-function-versions.md)
- [Get a Function Version](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-function-version.md)
- [List Function Builds](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-function-builds.md)
- [Get a Function Build](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-function-build.md)
- [Get Function Build Logs](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-function-build-logs.md)
- [Get an Invocation](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-an-invocation.md)
- [Get Invocation Logs](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-invocation-logs.md)
- [List Invocations for a Function Version](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-version-invocations.md)
- [Fetch a Page](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/fetch-a-page.md): Fetch a page and return its content, headers, and metadata.
- [Web Search](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/web-search.md): Perform a web search and return structured results.
- [Get a Keypair](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-keypair.md)
- [Create a Secret](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-a-secret.md)
- [List Secrets](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-secrets.md): List project secrets. Supports filtering by creation time.
- [Get a Secret](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-secret.md)
- [Update a Secret](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/update-a-secret.md): Replace a secret's value. The name cannot be changed; to rename, create a new secret and delete the old one.
- [Delete a Secret](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-a-secret.md)
- [Create a Webhook](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/create-a-webhook.md): Register an HTTPS endpoint to receive events for this project. The response includes the signing secret, which is shown only here and when the secret is rotated. Store it before discarding the response. An endpoint may only be registered once per project.
- [List Webhooks](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-webhooks.md): List the project's webhooks, newest first. Signing secrets are not included. Page by passing the previous response's `nextCursor` as `cursor`; a null `nextCursor` means there are no further pages.
- [Get a Webhook](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-webhook.md): Retrieve a single webhook by ID. The signing secret is not included; it is only ever returned on create and rotate.
- [Update a Webhook](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/update-a-webhook.md): Update a webhook's endpoint URL, its subscribed event types, or both. Omitted fields are left unchanged. `eventTypes` replaces the existing subscription rather than adding to it. The signing secret is unaffected.
- [Delete a Webhook](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/delete-a-webhook.md): Delete a webhook. Deliveries stop immediately and the signing secret is retired. Events that occurred before the delete are not replayed if the endpoint is registered again.
- [Rotate a Webhook signing secret](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/rotate-a-webhook-signing-secret.md): Issue a new signing secret for a webhook. By default the previous secret keeps verifying for 24 hours so a receiver can be updated without dropping deliveries; pass `revokeImmediately` to end that window at once. The new secret is returned only here.
- [List Projects](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/list-projects.md)
- [Get a Project](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-a-project.md)
- [Get Project Usage](https://docs.browserbase.com/reference/api/get-project-usage.md)

- [Browserbase MCP server](https://docs.browserbase.com/integrations/mcp/introduction.md): Give MCP clients a browser through Model Context Protocol integration with Stagehand
- [n8n integration](https://docs.browserbase.com/integrations/n8n/introduction.md): Build browser agents in n8n with the Browserbase node.

- [x402 protocol integration](https://docs.browserbase.com/integrations/x402/introduction.md): Pay-per-use browser sessions with crypto. No API keys, no accounts. Just pay and connect.
- [Mortgage rate capture](https://docs.browserbase.com/integrations/ibm/quickstart.md): This guide shows how to use Browserbase with IBM watsonx.ai to create a mortgage rate analysis tool.
